# grafana

Grafana, wired to whichever metrics, logs and traces backends the cluster has.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix from nix build .#referencePages -->

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| autoLogin | boolean | `false` | Skip the login form and go straight to the issuer.  Also disables the form, so a lab that turns this on and then loses its issuer has no way in at all. Off by default for that reason.  |
| chart | string | `upstream.chart` | Store path of the Grafana Helm chart. Required. |
| namespace | string | `"monitoring"` | Namespace Grafana runs in. |
| oidc | boolean | `false` | Log in through the lab's OIDC issuer.  Off by default: with nothing providing OIDC_PROVIDER this is refused rather than silently falling back to the admin password, and most labs that run Grafana do not run an issuer.  |
| storage | string | `"2Gi"` | Size of the volume dashboards and settings live on. |

## Requires

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | [KUBERNETES_CLUSTER](../signatures/KUBERNETES_CLUSTER.md) | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | [API_GATEWAY](../signatures/API_GATEWAY.md) | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| generation | [SECRET_GENERATION](../signatures/SECRET_GENERATION.md) | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| storageClass | [STORAGE_CLASS](../signatures/STORAGE_CLASS.md) | A StorageClass a PVC can name, and whether it is the cluster's default. |

## Requires, optionally

| hole | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| logs | [LOG_INGEST](../signatures/LOG_INGEST.md) | Where logs are pushed and queried. |

| oidc | [OIDC_PROVIDER](../signatures/OIDC_PROVIDER.md) | An OIDC issuer, its endpoints, and the CR a consumer registers a client with. |
| traces | [TRACE_INGEST](../signatures/TRACE_INGEST.md) | Where traces are sent and queried. |
